production.note: US model years. First: Audi of America's release "AUDI ANNOUNCES 2008 R8 U.S. PRICING" (Auburn Hills, 29 March 2007), and its 2008 model-year line-up release (audi-us-2008-lineup). Last: Kelley Blue Book (a database) lists R8 model years 2008-2012 and 2014-2015 for this generation, with no 2013 model year, and next 2017 (kbb-r8-years); its 2015 page lists the "V8 Coupe 2D" (kbb-r8-2015). The open R8 Spyder 4.2 and the V10 cars are not part of this record.

body.note: The open R8 Spyder is sold under its own name and is not part of this record.

displacementL.note: 4,163 cc per autoevolution (a database): "4163 cm3 (254 ci)". Audi of America: "4.2L FSI" (audi-us-2008-r8-pricing).

aspiration.note: Inferred: Audi describes a "high-revving 420-hp 4.2L V8 FSI engine" with no forced induction.

transmission.note: Audi of America: "The R8 with a six-speed manual transmission will have a manufacturer's suggested retail price of $109,000" and "Models equipped with the six-speed R tronic automatic gearbox will start at $118,000." R tronic is a single-clutch automated manual (2008-2012). For the 2014 model year KBB (a database) writes: "Power is routed to the rear-biased all-wheel-drive system via a smooth and precise 6-speed manual transmission or a nearly as satisfying 7-speed dual-clutch automatic." (S tronic; kbb-r8-2014).

powerHp.note: Quote (Audi of America release, 29 March 2007, reproduced by s-cars.org): "With a 420 hp V8 4.2L FSI engine and rear-biased quattro® all-wheel drive system, the R8 has the performance capabilities unlike any Audi before it." Audi's 2008 line-up release agrees: "The all-aluminum R8 has a 420 hp engine available with either a six-speed manual or R tronic sequential automatic gearbox, with sprints from 0-60 mph in 4.4 seconds." (audi-us-2008-lineup). 420 hp applied to the 2008-2011 model years (4 of the 7). KBB (a database) gives 430 hp for the 2012 car ("430 horsepower @ 7900 RPM", kbb-r8-2012) and 430 hp at 7,900 rpm for the 2014 and 2015 V8 Coupe (kbb-r8-2014, kbb-r8-2015); 420 hp still covers more than half of the model years, so the reference year is 2008.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL: two databases, agreeing within 0.3%. 2008 coupe with the 6-speed manual (the standard car). Quote (iSeeCars, a database): "AWD quattro 2dr Coupe 6M" "| Curb Weight | 3605 | lbs |" and "AWD quattro 2dr Coupe 6A" "| Curb Weight | 3616 | lbs |". KBB (a database), "R8 Quattro Coupe 2D", transmission "Manual": "Curb Weight | 3615 pounds" (kbb-r8-2008-specs). autoevolution's European unladen figure for the manual car, "Unladen Weight: 3439 lbs (1560 kg)" (autoevolution-r8-v8), is a European figure, not the US curb weight (see discrepancies).

discrepancies.reason: Rounding or data vintage between the US databases (iSeeCars 3,605 lb manual, 3,616 lb R tronic; KBB 3,615 lb listed as manual). 3,439 lb is autoevolution's European unladen figure (1,560 kg) for the manual car, not a US curb weight.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,605 lb, iSeeCars' figure for the manual car; the US figures agree within 0.3%.

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 3,605 lb (2008 manual coupe) rests on iSeeCars (a database), with KBB (a database) giving 3,615 lb. An Audi of America specification sheet for the 2008 R8 4.2 or a Car and Driver, Road & Track or MotorTrend specification panel would replace it. The end year (2015) and the 430 hp rating of 2012, 2014 and 2015 (described in the power note; the record uses the 2008-2011 rating of 420 hp from Audi of America) rest on KBB; displacement in cc rests on autoevolution.
